correctness.rationale: The first depth is determined by local color and opposite support mod singleton collapse. If the opposite support is non-singleton, Δ(χ_a ∧ Δχ_b) recovers the entire non-singleton own support via opposite-side uniformity. If opposite support singleton, all modal atoms are true. An induction using exact successor descriptors proves no further distinctions at arbitrary depth. Counting each realizable type gives q+q 2^(q-1)(2^q-q-1) and Boolean isolators give 2^r formulas. Witness K_{q,q} is coordinatewise minimal. Independent symbolic and concrete graph enumerations in verify.py agree.

originality.rationale: Full-text comparisons of three closest class-specific published results rule out direct theorem-level implication: multi-letter rooted stars have no reverse information, while complete multipartite and irreflexive clique type counts are only one-letter. The proof constructs a new two-way depth-two support detector and obtains an exact q-dependent spectrum. Recent proof-theory source is abstract-only, and historical priority remains provisional.
residual_risks: Full text of arXiv:2609.38975 not accessible in this run; available abstract is not sufficient to exclude every unmentioned quantitative application.
An older equivalent algebra/bisimulation type-enumeration argument under alternative terminology may be unindexed.
General completeness proofs could facilitate an alternative derivation; the exact count is not asserted as independent of known semantics.
